review_kind: Eleven complete one-file hardware acceleration package source-vetting decisions, not governed admission
macro_findings: Hardware acceleration subfamily has exactly 11 pinned direct-shape SKILL.md packages, each with a distinct blob and a one-file package tree; 11/11 now have individual source-vetting static decisions.

Cross-cutting hard-fail: commands launch profilers, training jobs, inference servers, network fabric probes or paid TPU/GPU workloads without action-specific execution, cost, data and endpoint authority.

Concrete correctness issues: FlashAttention code reuses SDPA (B,H,L,D) tensors for flash-attn_func (B,L,H,D); PTX inline memory load omits compiler memory clobber; CUDA warp reduction assumes a full active warp.
Reference methods retained for kernel design, SASS inspection, TPU architecture and Triton fusion. No package is approved unchanged or promoted to governed verified status.
New ml-accelerators domain needed because existing 32-domain ontology had no precise GPU kernel, inference, fabric or accelerator architecture route.
